Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you understand it is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Where were you sitting when the collision happened?
A: I was in the front passenger seat of my friend's sedan. We were stopped at a light on the main road in Pearland.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind us didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind, and our car was pushed forward into the vehicle
in front of us.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only in the side mirror for a second. It looked like it was moving too fast for the traffic that was stopped.
Q: Did you hit anything with your body inside the car?
A: My right knee struck the dashboard. It was a sharp pain right away, and it swelled up over the next hour.
Q: Did you get medical attention?
A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic that evening. They took X-rays and told me to keep weight off it and use a
brace.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and my knee locks sometimes. I have an appointment with an orthopedic specialist next
week.
Q: Did you have any knee problems before this collision?
A: No, not that I can recall. I played recreational softball, and I had no problems with that knee before.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: Only that my friend was also hurt, and we both want this handled fairly. I can send you the clinic records whenever
you need them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
